title: RTT Resonance Truth Claim
description: Schema for a Claim registered with the RTT Resonance Truth Service v0.1 model. A Claim represents an assertion to be evaluated. It does not contain or imply its own Truth State.

statement.description: The assertion being registered for evaluation.

truth_classes.description: One or more operational Truth Classes participating in evaluation of this Claim.

intended_use.description: Optional human-readable description of the operational purpose for which this Claim is being evaluated.

external_reference.description: Optional identifier or reference linking the Claim to an external record or system.

status.description: Lifecycle state of the Claim record. This is not a Truth-State status.

created_at.description: Timestamp at which the Claim was registered.

updated_at.description: Timestamp of the most recent Claim-record update.

metadata.description: Optional domain-specific or implementation metadata. Metadata must not override canonical Claim fields.

examples.statement: The current reference time is sufficiently synchronized for the declared display-clock regime.
Certificate C is acceptable for the declared operational use.
